what: Snapshots regenerated by a committed command instead of reviewed — the planted mistake

input.content:
name: verify
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npx vitest run -u
